description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maddewila - Welvitiya Divithara D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810545 (23/0374)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcel numbers, ownership (primarily "The State"), extent measurements, and possession/license details. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
